title: Bobby Ray Inman, Intelligence Official Under Carter and Reagan, Dies at 95
summary: An admiral who was a well-regarded director of the National Security Agency and deputy director of central intelligence, he turned down a nomination from President Bill Clinton to be secretary of defense.
